items.title: Adolphe Alexander Interview, 1961-03-08
items.q: Ike Graveson. He used to play trombone.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah, yeah. We must see him.
Ike Graveson, Ike Graveson. He live on Claiborne. Ike Graveson. I just can't, can't, couldn't think of him. Ike Graveson. He used to play trombone. Did you have a trumpet in that band?
Yeah, oh, Lawrence Stoker used to play trumpet.
